episode_audit_scope: 32 generated episodes per RNG stream; deliberate A/B pairs excluded

latent_leakage.precall_pair_test: bit-identical full histories for all five non-language actions
latent_leakage.strict_memory: all six cue-dependent actions leave identical postcue observations
latent_leakage.answer_encoding: response/cue/sensor only; gate bit and announced service conditions independent of answer
latent_leakage.scenario_context: synthetic physical affordances expose acquisition type; no numeric scenario ID input. This is an explicit task simplification, not an unseen-context generalization claim.
latent_leakage.timestamp: deadline flag is public and shared by A/B; no wall-clock or seed input

normalization.observations: fixed public physical scaling only; no fitted dataset statistics
normalization.advantage_and_return: training rollout only; validation/test never update parameters or normalization

tensor_memory_reuse: snapshot/restore and caller-observation clone tests passed; no shared mutable train/eval tensors
